evals.name: bounded-generic-helper
evals.prompt: Implement a generic Map and Filter utility function for slices with type constraints.
evals.expected_output: Clean, type-safe slice helper functions using [T any] and constraints.
assertions: Generic function signatures use idiomatic type parameters [T, R any].
Pre-allocates slice capacity based on input slice length.
Preserves type safety without runtime reflection or interface{} casting.

evals.name: generic-collection
evals.prompt: Implement a generic Set[T comparable] with Add, Contains, and ToSlice methods.
evals.expected_output: Type-safe Set struct parameterized on comparable with methods.
assertions: Backs set with map[T]struct{} to avoid memory overhead.
Methods operate safely on the generic type.

evals.name: avoid-overusing-generics
evals.prompt: Review a proposal to create a GenericRepository[T any] interface implemented across all bounded contexts.
evals.expected_output: Critique advising against generic domain repositories; recommending explicit domain-specific repository interfaces.
assertions: Explains that generic CRUD repositories obscure domain language and specific query requirements.
Advocates for consumer-driven interfaces tailored to each domain aggregate.
Clarifies that generics are best suited for data structures and utility algorithms, not domain contracts.
